text: Removing PAWL-027 AC14's pre-1.0 shifting assumes AC1 now carries the protection the shifting was standing in for. The shifting existed so 0.x could not be used as licence to change anything; with MAJOR narrowed to the CLI contract it mostly buys a smaller number. That it produces 0.1.0 rather than 0.0.1, matching what docs/install.md already documents, is a convenience and not the argument
